the PumaMart system can be used to facilitate autonomous and fast online buying and selling of goods by stationary and mobile agents while providing fast response for the consumers.

the parallel and agent based approach can be used in e-commerce to provide fast response to consumers, and the fuzzy based evaluation and negotiation can be employed to facilitate autonomous and intelligent shopping.

the following aspects of e-commerce: (a) the use of autonomous agents to facilitate automatic and parallel online shopping, (b) the use of fuzzy evaluation criterion and clustering based grading functions to provide fast response to consumers, (c) the use of auction-like negotiation model to facilitate the price competition between the sellers.
